3) Core @supports parsing & format validation (REQ-SUPPORTS-PARSE, REQ-FORMAT-VALIDATION, REQ-MIXED-SUPPORT) - src/rules/helpers/valid-implements-utils.ts - Declares responsibility explicitly: - `@story docs/stories/010.2-DEV-MULTI-STORY-SUPPORT.story.md` - `@req REQ-SUPPORTS-PARSE` / `REQ-FORMAT-VALIDATION` / `REQ-MIXED-SUPPORT` - MIN_IMPLEMENTS_TOKENS = 2 enforces “story path + at least one requirement ID”. - parseImplementsTokens(): - Trims raw value; on empty -> reportMissingImplementsValue (no story + no IDs). - Splits on whitespace; if fewer than MIN_IMPLEMENTS_TOKENS -> reportMissingImplementsReqIds (story only, no IDs). - Returns `{ storyPath, reqIds }` for structurally valid values. - validateImplementsTokens(): - Validates storyPath with options.storyPattern; if invalid, calls reportInvalidImplementsStoryPath. - Validates each reqId with options.reqPattern; invalid IDs reported via reportInvalidImplementsReqId using buildReqErrorMessage. - validateImplementsAnnotationHelper(): orchestrates parsing + validation. - src/rules/helpers/valid-annotation-format-validators.ts - `validateImplementsAnnotation` wraps validateImplementsAnnotationHelper. - This is wired into the valid-annotation-format rule. - tests/rules/valid-annotation-format.test.ts (selected cases): - Valid: - "[REQ-IMPLEMENTS-PARSE] valid single @supports with one story and one requirement (default patterns)": - Code: `@supports docs/stories/010.2-DEV-MULTI-STORY-SUPPORT.story.md REQ-IMPLEMENTS-PARSE`. - "[REQ-IMPLEMENTS-PARSE] valid multiple @supports lines with different stories and requirements". - "[REQ-MIXED-SUPPORT] valid mixed @story/@req/@supports usage in same block comment" (mixed style support). - Invalid (format/parse validation): - "[REQ-SUPPORTS-PARSE] @supports with no value is invalid": expects `invalidImplementsFormat` with “Missing story path and requirement IDs…”. - "[REQ-SUPPORTS-PARSE] @supports with only story path and no requirement IDs is invalid": expects specific missing-IDs error text. - "[REQ-FORMAT-VALIDATION] @supports with invalid story path format": invalidImplementsFormat with invalid story path string. - "[REQ-FORMAT-VALIDATION] @supports with invalid requirement ID format": invalidReqFormat error for bad ID. - "[REQ-FORMAT-VALIDATION] @supports with multiple requirement IDs where one is invalid": demonstrates per-ID validation. - src/rules/helpers/valid-annotation-format-internal.ts - normalizeCommentLine(): detects `@supports` tags alongside @story/@req. - isNonTraceabilityJSDocTagLine() explicitly excludes `@supports` from non-traceability tags. - Confirms parser recognizes supports consistently.
4) Deep requirement validation for @supports (REQ-SUPPORTS-VALIDATE, REQ-ERROR-CONTEXT, REQ-SCOPED-IDS) - src/rules/helpers/valid-req-reference-helpers.ts - File-level supports annotation: - `@supports docs/stories/010.2-DEV-MULTI-STORY-SUPPORT.story.md REQ-SUPPORTS-VALIDATE REQ-MIXED-SUPPORT REQ-SCOPED-IDS` - parseImplementsLine(line): - Splits on whitespace. - Uses IMPLEMENTS_TOKENS indices (STORY_INDEX=1, FIRST_REQ_INDEX=2) to extract storyPath and reqIds. - Returns null if storyPath missing or reqIds empty (ignored by deep rule per story’s guidance). - validateImplementsLine(): - Uses resolveStoryAndRequirements() to validate storyPath (traversal/absolute/project-boundary) and load requirements via loadAndCacheRequirements(). - Iterates all reqIds, calling checkRequirementExists() for each. - checkRequirementExists(): - If reqId not in reqSet, calls context.report with messageId "reqMissing" and data `{ reqId, storyPath }`. - This includes both requirement ID and the story path in the error (REQ-ERROR-CONTEXT). - loadAndCacheRequirements(): - Reads story file contents, extracts all `REQ-[A-Z0-9-]+` occurrences into a Set. - Cached per resolvedStoryPath key, so requirement ID scopes are per story file (REQ-SCOPED-IDS). - src/rules/valid-req-reference.ts - message template: `reqMissing: "Requirement '{{reqId}}' not found in '{{storyPath}}'"`. - Satisfies REQ-ERROR-CONTEXT and consistent error messaging. - tests/rules/valid-req-reference.test.ts - Valid @supports deep validation: - Single-line multi-req: `// @supports tests/fixtures/story_multi_a.md REQ-SHARED-ID REQ-ONLY-A` — succeeds when both IDs found in that story. - Multi-story supports: - `@supports ...story_multi_a.md REQ-SHARED-ID REQ-ONLY-A` - `@supports ...story_multi_b.md REQ-SHARED-ID REQ-ONLY-B` - Demonstrates same REQ-SHARED-ID used in multiple stories without conflict (REQ-SCOPED-IDS). - Invalid @supports deep validation: - Missing requirement: `@supports tests/fixtures/story_multi_a.md REQ-NOT-IN-A` ⇒ reports `reqMissing` with correct reqId and storyPath. - Path traversal: `@supports ../tests/fixtures/story_multi_a.md REQ-SHARED-ID` ⇒ reports invalidPath with storyPath containing `..`. - Confirms @supports lines are fully validated against their specific story files.
